title: Navier–Stokes Existence & Smoothness
subtitle: Unsolved problem
summary: Do smooth solutions to the 3D Navier–Stokes equations always exist? Clay Millennium Prize.
detail:
\[ rac{\partial u}{\partial t}+(u\cdot abla)u=- abla p+ u abla^2 u+f\]

In 3D, whether smooth initial conditions always produce a smooth global solution is unknown. Blow-up may occur. The 2D case is solved.
